# Contributing to Basil

Basil accepts bug reports, documentation improvements, tests, and focused code changes that preserve its local-first, user-controlled operating model.

## Before opening a pull request

- Search existing issues and pull requests before creating a duplicate.
- Keep changes narrowly scoped and include tests for changed behavior.
- Do not add credentials, model weights, build output, local databases, logs, or generated web bundles to the repository.
- Run the affected tests, formatter, type checks, and builds documented by the changed component.

## Developer Certificate of Origin

All contributions must be submitted under the Developer Certificate of Origin (DCO) 1.1. Add a `Signed-off-by` line to every commit:

```text
Signed-off-by: Your Name <your.email@example.com>
```

Use `git commit -s` to add the line automatically. By doing so, you certify:
